entries.english:
Photograph collection of Dr. agr. Alwiß Rosenberg (1906–1980)

Contains: portrait of Alwiß Rosenberg as a student; photographs of the Gerbstedt Artamans with eagle and falcon, 1925; photograph of Alwiß Rosenberg as leader of the Artaman group at Rinkendorf, 1926; photographs of the Artaman group at Limbach, 1927; photograph of Alwiß and Andor Rosenberg in the Artaman group at Markenthun, 1930; Alwiß Rosenberg’s student identity card, 1955; Alwiß Rosenberg’s identity card, 1955; photographs of various reunions of former Artamans in the 1960s and 1970s.
